# Performance Management Policy

## Annual Review Cycle

All employees undergo an annual performance review in Q4.
Reviews are conducted using a calibrated rating framework across five bands:
Exceptional, Strong, Meets Expectations, Below Expectations, and Unsatisfactory.
Managers submit ratings by December 1st each year.
The calibration process is completed by December 15th.

## Below Expectations Protocol

Employees who receive a Below Expectations rating in their annual review
are placed on a structured feedback programme managed by HR.
The programme is initiated within 10 working days of the rating being confirmed.
The employee's line manager and an HR business partner co-own the programme.
A formal programme plan is shared with the employee at the kickoff meeting.

## Improvement Plan Requirements

The structured feedback programme runs for a minimum of 90 days.
Clear and measurable objectives must be agreed within the first two weeks.
Progress is reviewed at formal checkpoints at the 30, 60, and 90 day marks.
The employee receives written feedback after each checkpoint.
Failure to demonstrate sustained improvement by day 90 may result in a formal
performance improvement plan or a change-of-role conversation.
